title: Hi, I'm Erica.
hoverTitle: But you can call me Kika.
aiIntro: I'm a human software developer learning to work alongside a tireless autocomplete that writes code faster than I do.
personalIntro: I enjoy finding practical solutions, having deep conversations, and occasionally getting lost in a good rabbit hole.
professionalSummary: I'm an early-career software developer with experience building and customizing full-stack applications for manufacturing systems. My recent work includes Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs.
